high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and accompanying map from IDRW.ORG, dated March 25, 2024. The headline reads: "India Issues NOTAM for Missile Firing Near Andaman and Nicobar Islands." The source of the information is attributed to the IDRW.ORG team. The map illustrates an area warning for India, specifically around the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. It highlights a "No Fly Zone" with a yellow shaded area indicating a likely missile test zone. The map specifies the start date as UTC 29/03/2024 at 0330
